name: plozasiran
uses: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE REDEMPLO is indicated as an adjunct to diet to reduce triglycerides in adults with familial chylomicronemia syndrome (FCS). REDEMPLO is an apolipoprotein C-III ( apoC-III )-directed small interfering ribonucleic acid (siRNA) indicated as an adjunct to diet to reduce triglycerides in adults with familial chylomicronemia syndrome (FCS). ( 1 )
pediatric: 8.4 Pediatric Use The safety and effectiveness of REDEMPLO in pediatric patients with FCS have not been established.
